content.text: I'll plan the subsystems first, then build bottom-up.
Rocky base: dark grey 8×8 mass, 3 courses with rough edge bricks.
Lower tower: 6×6 ring, red band with door, then white band.
Taper ledge plates, then 4×4 upper tower in four bands.
Gallery deck plates overhanging the tower top.
Red roof cap with cone, plus gallery railing posts.
Nothing extends past x[-4..4] per inspect and silhouette; the only parts at the extreme corner cells are the four black 1×1 accents — pulling them in.
